title: When entering DND mode hides already-visible notifications, exiting DND mode should not make them appear again
line: Notifications hidden when Do Not Disturb turns on now stay in the history instead of popping up again when it turns off.
explanation: Turning Do Not Disturb on only changed the popup model's filter, so popups already on screen were hidden but stayed active; turning it off removed the filter and they popped up again with a fresh timeout. libnotificationmanager now has Notifications::expireInhibitedPopups(), which the applet calls when Do Not Disturb starts: one event-loop turn later, once the popup model's Do Not Disturb filter is in place, it marks every active notification that model now hides as expired, so it stays in the history instead of coming back.

commits.message:
notifications: send popups hidden by Do Not Disturb to history

Popups on screen when Do Not Disturb turned on were only hidden, so they
popped up again with a fresh timeout once it ended. Mark the ones the
popup model now filters out as expired, so they stay in the history.

BUG: 524749

media.caption: Master: two 30 s popups (left), Do Not Disturb on hides them (middle), Do Not Disturb off brings both back with a fresh timeout (right).
Fixed: same steps, the popups stay gone after Do Not Disturb turns off; the bell shows unread notifications.
Both hidden notifications are in the history.
Konsole (allowed in Do Not Disturb) and a critical popup stay through Do Not Disturb; the Dolphin popup doesn't come back, and the summary counts only the one sent during Do Not Disturb.
